titles.title: Anthony Amoros Law Right to Know Act
Anthony Amoros Law Right to Know Act

To require the seller of a used motor vehicle sold through an auction, dealership, individual sale, or other resale channel to maintain a functional airbag system for the vehicle or clearly disclose when any airbag system is missing or disabled, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
